name: dev-experiments
description: A demo Gutenberg block plugin showcasing GitHub automation with AI tools
author: Your Team

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:js:fix && npm run lint:css:fix
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:php
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch -m 'chore: bump version to %s'
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor -m 'chore: bump version to %s'
scripts.version:major: npm version major -m 'chore: bump version to %s'
scripts.release: npm run test:all && npm run build && npm run plugin-zip
